product_one_liner.value: Qubrid AI gives developers, researchers, startups and enterprise teams GPU cloud infrastructure and model APIs to build, deploy and scale AI workloads.

named_customers.notes: Names displayed in the homepage customer-logo section headed ‘Powering teams at the world’s best companies’; this establishes teams/users, not necessarily organization-wide contracts.

employee_band.notes: PitchBook reports 16 employees; the company profile reports 19. Both fall within 11–20.

founded_year.notes: Uses the company profile’s founded year, 2024; PitchBook instead reports 2023, so public sources conflict.

eng_blog.notes: Technical and how-to articles exist, but the reviewed posts are attributed to “Qubrid Team”; two how-built posts with identifiable engineer authors could not be established.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation covers AI Model Studio, GPU infrastructure, serverless inference, integrations and organization management.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live official careers page lists Full Stack AI Engineer.

model_provider.value: Qwen (Alibaba), DeepSeek, Llama (Meta), Kimi (Moonshot AI), Mistral and NVIDIA Nemotron
model_provider.notes: Publicly offered/supported inference models; this does not imply exclusive provider relationships.

compliance_certs.notes: Scope caveat: documentation claims SOC Type II and HIPAA compliance for hosting data centers, not certification of Qubrid AI itself. No company-wide certification is established by this claim.

last_funding.notes: PitchBook’s latest completed round is Angel (individual), June 14, 2024; its amount is not disclosed there. Sources conflict: VCBacked lists a $250,000 April 2024 pre-seed, while Premier Alternatives calls a $25 million September 2026 seed completed; PitchBook labels that $25 million seed “Upcoming”. The unconfirmed seed is not treated as completed.

raised_18mo.notes: Using PitchBook’s completed-round history: its latest completed round predates May 9, 2025, and the $25 million seed remains “Upcoming”. A conflicting secondary page calls that seed September 2026; no dated company announcement or filing confirming completion was found.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The official live listing contains GPU Kubernetes Cluster Engineer and Full Stack AI Engineer, with no qualifying sales role. Older third-party sales advertisements do not establish a current opening.

launched_6mo.notes: The June 11, 2026 announcement introduces the live Model Comparison feature, including simultaneous comparison of two to four models; this falls within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The About page identifies the founder/CEO but is not a complete executive-team roster. No qualifying join or departure during November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 was verified. The located CTO appointment announcement is April 2024, outside the window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The Qubrid AI Technical Marketing Associate advertisement explicitly says “Maintain and update CRM (HubSpot/Zoho)”; this is a hiring-stack signal, not independent verification of both deployments.
